_meta.description: Jira Scrum Board Setup Payload — nicopxm.me Portfolio Site

instructions.step_1: POST each epic in the 'epics' array to POST /rest/api/3/issue
instructions.step_2: Create sprints via POST /rest/agile/1.0/board/{boardId}/sprint — use names from 'sprints' array
instructions.step_3: POST each story in 'issues' to POST /rest/api/3/issue — customfield_10014 references the epic summary string for linking
instructions.note_story_points: customfield_10016 is the standard Jira story points field. Some instances use customfield_10028. Confirm with GET /rest/api/3/field on your instance.
instructions.note_sprint: customfield_10020 accepts the sprint ID returned after step_2. Swap the placeholder string (e.g., 'SPRINT_1_ID') with the real numeric ID from the sprint creation response.

project.name: Portfolio Website — nicopxm.me
project.description: Astro 4 + Tailwind CSS + GitHub Pages portfolio site hosted at nicopxm.me. Features data analyst projects: Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis, Credit Risk Scorecard, and Automated Cryptocurrency Tracker.

content.text: All CI/CD, GitHub Actions pipeline configuration, GitHub Pages deployment, and custom domain (nicopxm.me) routing setup. Ensures zero-downtime automated deploys on every push to main.
Single-page Astro layout, responsive navigation bar, reusable project card components with modal overlays, Skills and About sections. Mobile-first, Tailwind CSS throughout.

Integration of all three featured data projects into the site (Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis, Credit Risk Scorecard, Automated Cryptocurrency Tracker), plus Jira sprint metrics visualization embedded in the site.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 — Foundation & Deploy Pipeline
sprints.goal: Establish a fully automated CI/CD pipeline deploying to nicopxm.me, and scaffold the single-page Astro layout with a functional navigation bar — so the live site exists and is reachable before a single line of content is written.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 — UI Components & First Two Projects
sprints.goal: Ship reusable project card and modal components, complete Skills/About/Contact sections, and integrate the Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis and Credit Risk Scorecard project cards — making the portfolio substantively complete for two-thirds of the featured work.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 — Active Project, Jira Metrics & Launch QA
sprints.goal: Integrate the in-progress Crypto Tracker project card, embed Jira sprint metrics screenshot into the site, perform cross-browser QA, and validate the live nicopxm.me deployment end-to-end — site is production-ready.

fields.summary: Configure CNAME file for nicopxm.me custom domain routing

content.text: As a site visitor, I want the portfolio to be reachable at nicopxm.me, so that I can access it via a professional branded URL instead of a raw GitHub Pages subdomain.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the repo root, when the build runs, then a CNAME file containing exactly 'nicopxm.me' exists in the public/ directory or repo root.
Given nicopxm.me DNS A/CNAME records point to GitHub Pages IPs, when a browser navigates to https://nicopxm.me, then the site loads without redirect errors.
Given GitHub Pages settings, when Custom Domain is saved, then 'Enforce HTTPS' is enabled and a valid SSL cert is provisioned.

fields.summary: Audit and update GitHub Actions deploy.yml for Astro + pnpm + GitHub Pages

content.text: As a developer, I want a CI/CD pipeline that automatically builds and deploys the Astro site to GitHub Pages on every push to main, so that I never need to manually run a build or upload files.
Acceptance Criteria
Given a push to the main branch, when the workflow triggers, then the build job uses withastro/action@v4 with package-manager: pnpm@latest.
Given a successful build, when the deploy job runs, then actions/deploy-pages@v4 publishes the dist/ artifact to the github-pages environment.
Given a failed build step, when the pipeline errors, then the deploy job is skipped and no broken build reaches production.
Given the astro.config.mjs, when site is set to 'https://nicopxm.me', then the deployed build uses the correct base URL.

fields.summary: Validate live deployment, SSL, and custom domain end-to-end

content.text: As a site owner, I want to confirm the production deployment is error-free across browsers and devices, so that I can confidently share nicopxm.me with recruiters and collaborators.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the live URL, when tested in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on desktop and mobile, then no layout breakages or JS errors appear in the console.
Given nicopxm.me, when loaded over HTTPS, then the SSL padlock is valid and no mixed-content warnings appear.
Given a fresh GitHub Actions run, when the pipeline completes, then the deployment URL resolves to the latest commit within 3 minutes.

fields.summary: Scaffold single-page Astro layout with MainLayout and index.astro section order

content.text: As a developer, I want a clean single-page Astro entry point that renders all sections in order (Hero → Projects → About → Skills → Contact), so that the full-page scroll experience is established from day one.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/pages/index.astro, when rendered, then it imports and renders Hero, Projects, About, Skills, and Contact sections in that DOM order.
Given src/layouts/MainLayout.astro, when any page uses it, then it injects BaseHead, Header, and Footer consistently.
Given pnpm dev, when the dev server starts, then no TypeScript or Astro compilation errors appear.

fields.summary: Build responsive Navigation Bar with smooth-scroll anchor links

content.text: As a site visitor, I want a persistent navigation bar with links to Home, Projects, About, Skills, and Contact sections, so that I can jump to any section without losing context of where I am on the page.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/components/Header.astro, when rendered, then it contains anchor links: #home, #projects, #about, #skills, #contact.
Given a mobile viewport (< 768px), when the nav renders, then links collapse into a hamburger menu or stacked layout without overflow.
Given a click on any nav link, when the browser scrolls, then the target section is reached with smooth scroll behavior (scroll-behavior: smooth).
Given scroll position, when the user is within a section's viewport bounds, then the corresponding nav link shows an active/highlighted state.

fields.summary: Build reusable ProjectCard component with detail modal overlay

content.text: As a site visitor, I want to click on a project card and see a modal with full project details (description, tech stack, links, and screenshots), so that I can evaluate the depth of work without leaving the page.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/components/Card.astro and src/components/Dialog.astro, when a project entry is passed as props, then the card renders a thumbnail image, project title, role/type tag, and tech stack tags.
Given a card click, when the modal opens, then it displays: full description, tech stack list, external link button, and at least one screenshot or chart image.
Given an open modal, when the user presses Escape or clicks outside, then the modal closes without a page reload.
Given src/data/projects.ts, when a new project object is added, then the card renders automatically without additional template changes.

fields.summary: Build Skills section with tag-chip display from src/data/skills.ts

content.text: As a recruiter, I want to see a scannable list of the developer's technical skills, so that I can quickly determine fit without reading full project descriptions.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/sections/Skills.astro, when rendered, then it imports skill data from src/data/skills.ts and renders each as a styled tag chip.
Given the data file, when a new skill string is added, then it appears in the section on next build without markup changes.
Given mobile viewport, when Skills section renders, then tags wrap responsively with no horizontal overflow.

fields.summary: Build About and Contact sections with bio copy and email/social links

content.text: As a recruiter or collaborator, I want to read a brief personal bio and find direct contact links, so that I can reach out without friction after reviewing the portfolio.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/sections/About.astro, when rendered, then it displays a profile image, 2–3 sentence bio, and location/role context.
Given src/sections/Contact.astro, when rendered, then it displays a mailto link and at least one social profile link (LinkedIn or GitHub).
Given a click on the email link, when the OS mail client opens, then the To field is pre-populated with the correct address.

fields.summary: Integrate Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis project card and modal

content.text: As a site visitor, I want to see and explore the Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis project, so that I can understand the developer's Python data engineering and Tableau visualization skills.
Acceptance Criteria

Given src/data/projects.ts, when a Kendrick Lamar Discography Analysis entry is added with tags ['Python', 'Tableau', 'Pandas', 'Audio Analysis', 'Data Viz'], then the ProjectCard renders it in the Projects section.

Given the project modal, when opened, then it describes the audio feature extraction methodology (e.g., BPM, energy, valence via Spotify API or librosa) and links to the live multi-page Tableau dashboard.
Given the modal, when it renders, then at least one Tableau dashboard screenshot or embedded chart preview is visible.
Given the project entry, when GitHub repo URL is supplied, then an external link button opens the repo in a new tab.

fields.summary: Integrate Credit Risk Scorecard project card and modal

content.text: As a site visitor, I want to see and explore the Credit Risk Scorecard project, so that I can evaluate the developer's machine learning, model evaluation, and GitHub deployment skills.
Acceptance Criteria
Given src/data/projects.ts, when a Credit Risk Scorecard entry is added with tags ['Python', 'scikit-learn', 'Logistic Regression', 'ML', 'Risk Modeling', 'GitHub'], then the ProjectCard renders it.
Given the project modal, when opened, then it explains the model approach (e.g., logistic regression, feature engineering, ROC-AUC metric) and links to the deployed GitHub repository.
Given the modal, when rendered, then at least one model performance visualization (confusion matrix, ROC curve, or scorecard output) is shown as a static image.

fields.summary: Integrate Automated Cryptocurrency Tracker project card and modal (Active/In-Progress)

content.text: As a site visitor, I want to see the Automated Cryptocurrency Tracker project clearly marked as active/in-progress, so that I can see the developer is currently shipping work and understands real-time data pipelines.
Acceptance Criteria

Given src/data/projects.ts, when a Crypto Tracker entry is added with tags ['Python', 'Telegram Bot API', 'Supabase', 'Coinbase API', 'Automation', 'PostgreSQL'] and a status: 'active' field, then the card renders with a visible 'In Progress' badge.
Given the project modal, when opened, then it describes the architecture: Python polling script → Coinbase API → threshold logic → Telegram alert → Supabase logging.
Given the modal, when rendered, then a system architecture diagram or sample Telegram alert screenshot is displayed.
Given the in-progress status, when the card renders, then it does not show a broken external link — if repo is private, the link button is hidden or replaced with a 'Coming Soon' label.

fields.summary: Embed Jira sprint metrics and board screenshot into the site

content.text: As a site visitor, I want to see a visual artifact from the Jira board used to build this site, so that I can verify the developer practices structured Agile project management, not just coding.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the completed Sprint 3 burndown or board screenshot, when exported and saved to public/assets/, then it is referenced in a dedicated 'Process' subsection or within the About section.
Given the metrics image, when rendered on the page, then it includes a caption explaining: sprint cadence (1 week), total story points (15–20 SP), and tools used (Jira, GitHub Actions).
Given mobile viewport, when the metrics image renders, then it scales responsively without cropping the sprint data.
